The document claims the field is aligned with canonical `PeriodPrecheck`/`period.precheck.get/v1`, but this projection cannot validate against that schema and wrongly narrows the status enum. Fix: either make the precheck object a real canonical PeriodPrecheck (all required fields and full enum) plus a separate named extension object, or explicitly name it a projection and give a complete field/status mapping; do not claim canonical alignment while emitting a non-canonical precheck.
